```python
import sys
import json
import numpy as np
import cv2


def analyze_image(image_path, ocr_text):
    result = {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }

    try:
        # Read image with Chinese path support
        data = np.fromfile(image_path, dtype=np.uint8)
        img = cv2.imdecode(data, cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)

        if img is None:
            return result

        h, w = img.shape[:2]
        if h == 0 or w == 0:
            return result

        gray = cv2.cvtColor(img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)

        # White background ratio
        _, binary = cv2.threshold(gray, 240, 255, cv2.THRESH_BINARY)
        white_ratio = float(np.sum(binary == 255)) / (h * w)

        # Sample pixels for color analysis
        pixels = img.reshape(-1, 3)
        sample_size = min(10000, len(pixels))
        idx = np.random.choice(len(pixels), sample_size, replace=False)
        sample_px = pixels[idx].astype(np.int32)

        unique_colors = len(np.unique(sample_px, axis=0))
        max_ch = np.max(sample_px, axis=1)
        min_ch = np.min(sample_px, axis=1)
        color_diff = max_ch - min_ch
        colored_ratio = float(np.sum(color_diff > 30)) / sample_size

        # Dark pixel ratio (text/lines)
        dark_ratio = float(np.sum(gray < 50)) / (h * w)

        # ---- OCR keyword matching ----
        ocr_upper = ocr_text.upper()

        arch_keywords = [
            "CNN", "TRANSFORMER", "ATTENTION", "ENCODER", "DECODER",
            "BLOCK", "EMBEDDING", "CLASSIFIER", "FEATURE EXTRACTOR",
            "ALEXNET", "RESNET", "VGG", "GOOGLENET", "DENSENET",
            "BERT", "GPT", "UNET", "YOLO", "RNN", "LSTM", "GRU",
            "POOLING", "CONVOLUTION", "BACKBONE", "NECK", "HEAD",
            "MULTI-HEAD", "SELF-ATTENTION", "CROSS-ATTENTION",
            "FEED FORWARD", "LAYER NORM", "POSITIONAL ENCODING",
            "MASK", "TOKEN", "PATCH", "VIT", "MOBILENET",
            "INCEPTION", "SHUFFLENET", "SQUEEZENET", "HRNET",
            "FPN", "PNAS", "MLP-MIXER", "DETR", "BATCH NORM"
        ]

        exp_keywords = [
            "ACCURACY", "LOSS", "EPOCH", "PRECISION", "RECALL",
            "F1", "F1-SCORE", "CURVE", "COMPARISON", "PERFORMANCE",
            "RESULT", "TRAIN", "TEST", "VALIDATION", "TOP-1", "TOP-5",
            "BATCH", "LR", "LEARNING RATE", "OPTIMIZER", "EVALUATION",
            "BENCHMARK", "STATE-OF-THE-ART", "SOTA", "ABLATION",
            "IOU", "MAP", "MIOU", "ROC", "AUC", "AVERAGE",
            "OVERALL", "DELTA", "IMPROVEMENT", "BASELINE",
            "CONVERGENCE", "ITERATION", "STEP", "STEP SIZE",
            "CONFUSION", "MATRIX", "ROC CURVE", "PR CURVE",
            "PARAMETERS", "FLOPS", "THROUGHPUT", "FPS", "LATENCY"
        ]

        data_keywords = [
            "SAMPLE", "DATASET", "CLASS", "INPUT", "LABEL",
            "MNIST", "CIFAR", "IMAGENET", "PASCAL", "VOC",
            "COCO", "EXAMPLE", "ORIGINAL", "GROUND TRUTH",
            "ANNOTATION", "SEGMENTATION", "BBOX", "BOUNDING BOX",
            "AUGMENTATION", "CROP", "RESIZE", "NORMALIZE"
        ]

        arch_found = [kw for kw in arch_keywords if kw in ocr_upper]
        exp_found = [kw for kw in exp_keywords if kw in ocr_upper]
        data_found = [kw for kw in data_keywords if kw in ocr_upper]

        # ---- Visual heuristics ----
        is_chart_like = False
        is_grid_like = False

        # Charts: often have colored bars/lines on white background
        if colored_ratio > 0.03 and white_ratio > 0.45:
            is_chart_like = True

        # Dense charts with many colored elements
        if colored_ratio > 0.10:
            is_chart_like = True

        # Dataset grids: multiple similar-sized images arranged in rows
        # Use row/column color variance as proxy
        row_means = np.mean(gray, axis=1)
        col_means = np.mean(gray, axis=0)
        row_var = np.std(row_means)
        col_var = np.std(col_means)

        # Grid-like: periodic variation in rows/cols
        if row_var > 15 and col_var > 15 and white_ratio < 0.5:
            is_grid_like = True

        # ---- Classification (priority: experiment > architecture > dataset > other) ----
        type_val = "other"
        desc = "无法确定图片类型"
        components = []
        code_info = ""

        # Check experiment_result first (highest priority)
        if exp_found:
            type_val = "experiment_result"
            desc = "展示实验结果和性能评估指标"
            components = exp_found[:8]
            code_info = "需要实现相应的评估指标计算和实验结果对比展示功能"
        elif is_chart_like and not arch_found and not data_found:
            type_val = "experiment_result"
            desc = "展示实验结果图表和性能变化"
            components = []
            code_info = "需要实现实验结果可视化和性能指标评估功能"

        # Check architecture (second priority)
        if type_val == "other" and arch_found:
            type_val = "architecture"
            desc = "展示模型网络结构和数据流关系"
            components = arch_found[:8]
            comp_str = ", ".join(arch_found[:5])
            code_info = "需要实现以下模型组件: " + comp_str

        # Check dataset (third priority)
        if type_val == "other" and data_found:
            type_val = "dataset"
            desc = "展示数据样本和类别示例"
            components = data_found[:8]
            code_info = "需要实现数据加载、预处理和类别管理模块"

        # Visual fallback
        if type_val == "other":
            if is_chart_like:
                type_val = "experiment_result"
                desc = "展示实验结果图表"
                code_info = "需要实现实验结果可视化功能"
            elif is_grid_like:
                type_val = "dataset"
                desc = "展示数据样本网格"
                code_info = "需要实现数据加载和预处理模块"

        result = {
            "type": type_val,
            "description": desc,
            "important_components": components,
            "code_relevant_information": code_info
        }

    except Exception:
        result = {
            "type": "other",
            "description": "无法确定图片类型",
            "important_components": [],
            "code_relevant_information": ""
        }

    return result


def main():
    result = {
        "type": "other",
        "description": "无法确定图片类型",
        "important_components": [],
        "code_relevant_information": ""
    }

    try:
        if len(sys.argv) < 2:
            print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))
            return

        image_path = sys.argv[1]
        ocr_text = "6517 0631"

        result = analyze_image(image_path, ocr_text)

    except Exception:
        pass

    print(json.dumps(result, ensure_ascii=False))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
```
